title: Fixed Radial Turret and Opposed Anvil Hand Punch
description: One newly authored whole fixed rotary-head hand-punch-style exterior in a flat open pose. Two complete crossed long metal handle bodies share one central retained pivot and two thick dark grips. One front body forms a genuinely open two-level fork with a rear bridge and a full separate radial turret disc on its own transverse axle. Six complete short thick hollow blunt-ended radial mouths belong to that one turret, with one mouth facing a separate flat anvil on the other jaw across a visible fixed gap. The rotating-head organization, fork axle and opposed anvil distinguish this whole tool from ordinary serrated jaws and from the stationary two-guide desktop paper punch. All whole coordinates newly authored; no old visible tool pieces imported. Three opaque PBR roles, one prop zero scenes. No sharp cutting edges, punched material, selectable tooling, alignment certification, rotation, gripping/punching performance, force, hand fit, electrical insulation, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
